why: The docs site is the named consumer of mdxComponents (adopt-or-delete): the recipe and token pages render the shipped recipes through it. Second of three marketing Issues.
what: The recipe pages, tokens and colour page and the MDX fixture test, rendered through mdxComponents from basalt-ui/page.
must_not_touch: .github/workflows/deploy.yml and apps/marketing/{Dockerfile,nginx.conf} unless the build needs it (then say so)
contract: DIRECTION.md DPO 19 and 12a; ai-mdx.md decision 6 and P9; static-framework-free (themeScript inlined in the layout via Astro set:html; .vx-prose for typography). Depend on the published `basalt-ui` exactly 3.0.0, not workspace:*, so a v3 package build cannot turn the marketing deploy red. Content source: the installed tarball. `packages/basalt-ui/package.json` `files` lists llms.txt and MIGRATING.md but NOT docs/ today: before starting run `ls node_modules/basalt-ui/docs/recipes`; if absent, stop and signal (the fix is a `files` entry plus a patch release, not this Issue).
exemplar: apps/playground in this repo for the v3 frame; the shipped docs/recipes/*.md and generated llms.txt as content sources.
change: Recipe pages rendered from the synced docs/recipes through mdxComponents (every entry exercised: h2-h4, a, table, blockquote, Callout, Steps, Step, Tabs, Tab, Figure, Kbd), with client:load island wrappers in src/components/mdx.tsx for Tabs and Steps if Astro does not hydrate them (reversible default); a tokens and colour page. Test: a build-time bun test compiles one MDX fixture with every mdxComponents entry and asserts each key appears in the HTML. Rule: the app preset passes. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Two commits in one PR: packages/basalt-ui/** apart from everything else (isolated-basalt-ui hook); `make sync-self` output its own non-package commit; conventional, empty scope, plain feat:/fix:/chore:/docs:, no feat! or BREAKING CHANGE, no attribution; rebase-merge. Deploys on push to master through RollHook.
proof: Shots of one recipe page and the tokens page at 1800x1200 and 390x844, dark and light, at most 3 rounds, basalt-design reviewer.
acceptance: `bun run --cwd apps/marketing build` exits 0 and one HTML page exists per synced docs/recipes/*.md
`rg -n 'mdxComponents' apps/marketing/src` shows the import from basalt-ui/page
the MDX fixture test asserts all 13 mdxComponents keys render and an `a` with href `//h` is blocked
`basalt-ui doctor` and `basalt-ui lint` exit 0 in apps/marketing

`gh run list --workflow deploy.yml --branch master --limit 1 --json conclusion,headSha` shows success for the merged sha (the factory does not deploy this repo: deploy mode none), then `make verify` exits 0; before that state it not-run; `curl -fsS https://basalt-ui.com/recipes/` returns 200
out_of_scope: The frame, the migration page, changing the package or the deploy pipeline.
